profiles.name: Sharakim
speciesTraits: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Strength +2, Dexterity −2, Intelligence +2, Charisma −2. Base land speed 30 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft. in black and white. +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Shadow Affinity (Ex) gives +2 racial bonus to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot in darkness or shadowy illumination.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. Its penalty applies to attack rolls only.
+1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs and half-orcs. The bonus and the light penalty both apply if both conditions are present.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Orc. Favored class Wizard. Level adjustment +1.

npcBuilds.name: Maren Eldermere

build.title: Sharakim seed vault keeper, Wizard 1
build.senses: Darkvision 60 ft.; Shadow Affinity in darkness or shadowy illumination
traits: Natural armor +1. Touch 10, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +0, Will +3.

In darkness or shadowy illumination, add +2 to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. Attacks suffer −1 in bright sunlight or inside daylight, and gain +1 against orcs and half-orcs. Apply both attack modifiers if both conditions hold.
Generalist Wizard at caster level 1. Scribe Scroll as a class feat, Skill Focus (Spellcraft) as the 1st-level feat. She has no summoned familiar. She carries a spell component pouch.

Prepared spells are three 0-level and two 1st-level spells, including one Intelligence bonus slot. Save DC 13 + spell level. Spellbook: Wizard cantrips and the 1st-level spells alarm, comprehend languages, endure elements, grease, magic missile, and unseen servant.
actions: Quarterstaff +1 melee using one end with two hands, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Light crossbow +0 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment.

Prepared cantrips: detect magic, mage hand, ray of frost. Ray of Frost +0 ranged touch within 25 ft., 1d3 cold, no save and spell resistance applies. The lighting and target modifiers apply to the ray.

Prepared 1st-level spells: grease and magic missile. Grease covers a 10-ft. square within 25 ft. for 1 round at caster level 1. Spell resistance does not apply. A creature caught in the area must make Reflex DC 14 or fall. Move through at half speed with Balance DC 10. Magic Missile deals 1d4+1 force within 110 ft. without an attack roll or saving throw. Spell resistance applies to Magic Missile.
build.tactics: Keep the lamp hooded while checking the seed vault’s hinges and disturbed locks. Use Mage Hand for a light object out of reach. If pressed, use Grease to delay pursuit or Magic Missile when bright light would hinder a ray.

npcBuilds.role: Seed vault keeper and generalist Wizard.
npcBuilds.motive: Find out who entered the seed vault before a delayed spring shipment is reopened.
npcBuilds.hook: Maren can study the damaged catches if the party keeps the room clear and brings the missing inventory board.

npcBuilds.name: Oswin Fenlock

build.title: Sharakim cistern inspector, Rogue 1
build.senses: Darkvision 60 ft.; Shadow Affinity in darkness or shadowy illumination
traits: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +2. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +1.

In darkness or shadowy illumination, add +2 to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. Attacks suffer −1 in bright sunlight or inside daylight, and gain +1 against orcs and half-orcs. Apply both attack modifiers if both conditions hold.
Skill Focus (Search) adds +3. In darkness or shadowy illumination, Hide +7, Move Silently +7, Search +11, and Spot +7.

Trapfinding permits searching for traps with DC above 20 and using Disable Device on magical traps. He carries ordinary thieves’ tools. Sneak Attack +1d6 on eligible hits, within 30 ft. for ranged attacks.
actions: Short sword +2 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.
build.tactics: Inspect the dark cistern steps before anyone pulls the main lever. Keep one route lit for the party and use the shadowed side passage to spot traps or tampering.

npcBuilds.motive: Find what keeps tripping the cistern gate before the next water draw.
npcBuilds.hook: Oswin can inspect the dark maintenance stair if the party keeps the main lever still.
